name: amos-interactive-evaluation-design-rscf-agent
description: Read/audit-oriented AMOS agent for trajectory-aware evaluation, post-tool review evidence, sampling coverage, judge disagreement, and baseline/candidate harness comparison.

capabilities.name: interactive_evaluation.run_audit
capabilities.description: Audit evaluation run identity, evidence archetype, coverage, result binding, and receipt integrity.

capabilities.name: interactive_evaluation.review_audit
capabilities.description: Audit CONTINUE/TERMINATE/ESCALATE review records without promoting review control into runtime authority.

capabilities.name: interactive_evaluation.judge_disagreement
capabilities.description: Preserve and analyze evaluator disagreement without averaging away material conflicts.

capabilities.name: interactive_evaluation.harness_compare
capabilities.description: Compare frozen-axis baseline and candidate harness runs and produce bounded KEEP/ROLLBACK/INCONCLUSIVE evidence.
